Gold, silver, and crypto all fall as higher-for-longer rate expectations dominate

Multiple Chapter 11 filings (dining chain, firearms retailer) signal consumer/retail stress

China bond sales accelerating, shifting focus to PBOC monetary policy

Global bond selloff and rising rate-hike expectations
China decoupling and India as beneficiary
Commodity complex (oil, gas, gold, silver) in flux
Currency volatility (USD strength, JPY weakness past 160)
Regulatory and political interference in markets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran military escalation and Hormuz Strait disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy equities (XOM, CVX), increase gold allocation, maintain cash reserves; monitor Brent above $100 trigger

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond selloff and rising yields (30Y at 5.25%, EU at 15-yr highs)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favor floating-rate notes; avoid long-duration growth; lock in CD rates at 4.30% APY
Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favor energy and inflation-hedged assets; monitor JOLTS and CPI prints
Diversify away from long-duration US Treasuries; monitor Treasury issuance; consider TIPS and short-dated bills
Avoid overleveraged consumer names; favor essential consumer staples; monitor Chapter 11 filings as leading indicator

risk_assessment.risk_factor: JPY weakness past 160 and currency volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge JPY exposure; monitor BOJ intervention thresholds; USD strength supports importers
Scrutinize AI capex quality; favor companies with organic revenue vs. circular funding; monitor NVDA balance sheet

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face 1-3 month headwind from Iran escalation, bond selloff, and rate-hike repricing. Expect elevated volatility, oil above $90, and continued pressure on growth equities. JOLTS at 7.27M supports labor market but fuels inflation fears. Defensive rotation likely continues.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook hinges on Iran conflict resolution and Fed policy path. AI capex cycle (Anthropic, Palantir) provides structural growth. India benefits from China decoupling. US debt sustainability remains overhang. If oil normalizes, equities recover; if conflict persists, stagflation risk rises.
